snapshot.title: docs: document controlled Codex review operation
snapshot.body:
Agentic implementation of #59.

Created by the Phase 2 /implement workflow tracked in #44.

The implementation was produced by Claude Code after the trigger actor was verified as having repository write, maintain, or admin access. Pull Request CI and the later review/GUI/judge phases remain responsible for validation and merge decisions.

exact_reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended The new `/codex-review` documentation currently implies the controller always posts a new `@codex review` request comment, but the implementation can reuse an existing same-SHA request marker without posting again, so the documented contract is slightly inaccurate. *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview This PR updates the agentic development workflow documentation to explicitly describe the operator-controlled `/codex-review` path for re-triggering Codex review on an open same-repository PR, including head-SHA pinning, terminal-result reuse, and fail-closed behavior. **Changes:** - Documented the manual `/codex-review` trigger flow, including permission checks and author trust requirements. - Documented head SHA resolution/fixation and reuse of existing terminal `hane/codex-review` commit status to avoid duplicate Codex requests. - Added a Phase 3 checklist reference pointing readers to the new manual re-review section.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | docs/agentic-development-workflow.md | Adds the manual `/codex-review` operational contract (authorization, SHA pinning, reuse, pending publication, fail-closed outcomes) and references it from Phase 3. |
Review details - **Files reviewed:** 1/1 changed files - **Comments generated:** 1 - **Review effort level:** Lite
